title: Public exact polynomial resource division
objective: Route public ZZ[x] and QQ[x] exact division directly from canonical generated FLINT resources to generated quotient resources, eliminating packed compatibility materialization and capacity retries while preserving exact-division semantics and portable fallbacks.

handoff.summary: Public exact ZZ[x] and QQ[x] floor division now preserves canonical generated FLINT resources end to end. Resource operands call generated fmpz_polynomial_divexact or fmpq_polynomial_divexact directly and publish the returned owned resource before any coefficient-length query or compatibility materialization. The packed portable and finite-field paths remain unchanged. Focused tests forbid legacy polynomial N-API, replace compatibility materialization with a throwing sentinel, exercise native-disabled execution, and cover exact and zero quotients, nonexact and zero-divisor failures, 4096-bit skew, source immutability, and resource-backed results. Degree-5000 by degree-1000 performance gates measure about 0.65 ms over ZZ and 0.71 ms over QQ; the direct public route is 46-79 times faster than deliberately restoring the former compatibility path on the benchmark workload.
risks: Generated exact polynomial resources currently declare wasm=False, so browser hosts continue through the retained packed fallback until resource lowering exists.
The arithmetic bootstrap source budget has only 162 bytes of headroom and should be deliberately rebalanced before more polynomial surface growth.
next_steps: Integrate the lane commit and rerun the focused public polynomial test against the merged generated FFI declarations.
Migrate exact polynomial factorization to an owned generated factorization resource so it no longer materializes packed coefficient storage.
